sources.title: CASdatasets French motor third-party liability datasets
sources.use: Benchmark frequency/severity methods with policy exposure, risk features, claim counts and linked claim amounts.
sources.limitations: French portfolio, not INSON or Uzbekistan. freMTPL2 observations are approximately 2011–2013 and mostly one year per policy. Some claim amounts follow French settlement conventions. Not a direct import to the application's recent 3–5 complete-year paid-loss calibration workflow; do not invent years, currency conversion, or paid-loss semantics.

sources.title: Casualty Actuarial Society — Basic Ratemaking
sources.use: Review property/casualty ratemaking concepts and methods.
sources.limitations: Educational methodology; does not provide insurer-approved INSON coefficients or replace actuarial review.
